DIRECTION A — Aurora Console (leading)
Instrument-panel feel: deep cool canvas, hairline depth, one luminous accent. Everything visible at once — no accordions, no modal 'Try it out'.
The actual thesis: Swagger is route-centric, this is DOMAIN-centric. Pick an entity, see its shape, every route that touches it, and what it pulls in.

DIRECTION B — Blueprint
Same product, opposite axis: warm paper, ink rules, one signal orange, zero glow. Reads as technical documentation rather than a cockpit. Slower, more authoritative; less 'futuristic'.
